answer: Require a zenith checkpoint of sustained, costly participation: a new identity earns full standing only after completing a long sequence of verifiable, non-transferable tasks spread over many epochs, with its work linked into a nebula of cross-checked contributions that peers can audit. Short bursts cannot be faked cheaply, and a dune of abandoned lookalike accounts leaves a visible trail, so a Sybil operator must fund months of distinct, consistent work for every fake, while a genuine agent pays that cost once.
